structuredContent.about: Be Sweet: give someone a treat and a short voice affirmation, in your own voice. It grew out of the ECI Loves Goa Baking Co. pop-up bakery at Edge City India, where a kind word was spoken over every mango mochi heart. Gift only; nothing is sold.

prompts.text: What will you carry from knowing them?
What did they leave with you that you want them to know about?
Finish this sentence for them: I appreciate you because…

structuredContent.privacy_note: Answer these for yourself, or say them straight to the person. Please don't type your answers or their name to your agent: Agent Village stores what you tell it, and its staff and researchers can read it.
structuredContent.guidance: Say it in your own voice. Twenty seconds is plenty.
structuredContent.how_to_send: Record it as a voice note on your own phone and send it yourself, or say it in person.
rules: The words are yours: nobody writes or speaks them for you.
